items.title: Fadnavis, Himanta Sarma criticise INDIA bloc march to SC
items.summary: BJP leaders Devendra Fadnavis and Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma accused the INDIA bloc of undermining constitutional institutions over the Chalo Dilli march to the Supreme Court. Sarma alleged Rahul Gandhi is trying to exert political pressure on the CJI, claimed Congress rejects electoral outcomes in Assam while welcoming Kerala's, and accused it of blackmailing institutions and opposing SIR to shield illegal infiltrators. Sarma announced BJP Assam will hold peaceful mass rallies at every district headquarters from tomorrow until October 31. (ANI via syndicated feed)

items.title: ANI: fresh quotes from CJP's Parliament Street police-station visit
items.summary: ANI's wire report on the morning Parliament Street PS visit adds attributed quotes: Saurav Das — 'Police tells everyone to approach them 10 days in advance. We are now saying that they have the choice to tell us the date and time (for protest at Jantar Mantar). We are giving them 24-hour ultimatum.' Ashutosh Ranka — 'We are going to ask Delhi Police for a date to hold a protest at Jantar Mantar. We hope the police will give us a date. If they do not, we will make another call within 24 hours.' Advances the already-reported visit with on-record wording.
